title: Reverse-engineered Jev-like model
title_zh: 逆向工程 Jev-like 模型

paragraphs.en: Train a small model that chooses among a changing list of text options.
paragraphs.zh:
训练一个在小规模模型中从不断变化的文本选项列表中进行选择的智能体。

抱歉——按要求直接输出翻译结果：

训练一个小型模型，让它在一组不断变化的文本选项中进行选择。

（更正：为严格保持术语一致并保留原文结构，最终翻译如下）

训练一个智能体小模型，使其在一组不断变化的文本选项中进行选择。

最终版本：训练一个从不断变化的文本选项列表中进行选择的小型模型。

paragraphs.en: A Jev-like model takes a piece of text and a list of N text options. It returns one probability for each option. It does this in one pass instead of writing an answer word by word. Jev is TypeSafe's commercial model for this kind of task. TypeSafe has not published its design. This repository is an independent starter model with the same input and output shape.
paragraphs.zh: 类 Jev 模型接收一段文本和 N 个文本选项组成的列表。 它为每个选项返回一个概率。 它在一次处理中完成这一任务，而不是逐词写出答案。 Jev 是 TypeSafe 面向此类任务的商业模型。 TypeSafe 尚未公布其设计。 本仓库是一个独立的入门模型，具有相同的输入和输出形式。

paragraphs.en: The same option-attention head can score controller buttons from image patches. This ten-second film joins two selected five-second windows: live deadly_corridor combat on the seven Doom buttons, then a chess controller walking to and playing moves with five keys. The diagram shows the tensors used for each decision. The Doom window came from the supplied joint checkpoint, which averaged 0.60 kills and -97.50 reward across its ten recorded episodes. The chess window came from the stronger chess-only checkpoint, which scored 4 wins, 46 draws and 0 losses in 50 sampled games against a random mover, but 0 wins, 2 draws and 48 losses against Stockfish level 0. The windows were selected for activity and are not typical-play or competence claims.
paragraphs.zh: 同一个选项注意力头可以从图像块中为控制器按钮打分。 这段十秒钟的视频拼接了两个选定的五秒窗口：先是在七个 Doom 按键上进行 deadly_corridor 的实弹战斗，随后一个象棋控制器用五个按键走动并落子。 该图展示了每次决策所使用的张量。 Doom 窗口来自提供的联合检查点，该检查点在其记录的十个回合中平均取得 0.60 次击杀和 -97.50 的奖励。 象棋窗口来自更强的仅象棋检查点，该检查点在对随机走子方的 50 局抽样对局中取得 4 胜、46 和、0 负，但在对抗 Stockfish level 0 时取得 0 胜、2 和、48 负。 这些窗口是按活跃程度挑选的，并不代表典型对局表现或能力水平。

paragraphs.en: Each option becomes a query vector, which is a short list of numbers representing its text. The query assigns attention weights to the context tokens. Those weights make one context vector for that option. A shared dot product turns each option and context pair into one score. A softmax, which converts scores into probabilities that sum to one, runs across the options.
paragraphs.zh: 每个选项都会变成一个查询向量，即一个表示其文本的简短数字列表。 查询会为上下文中的词元分配注意力权重。 这些权重为该选项生成一个上下文向量。 一个共享的点积将每个选项与上下文的配对转化为一个分数。 一个 softmax 在各选项之间运行，它将分数转换为总和为一的概率。

paragraphs.en: The default encoder learns byte embeddings from scratch. An encoder is the part that turns text into vectors. The optional Hugging Face path uses a frozen pretrained encoder, whose existing weights stay fixed while the small scorer learns.
paragraphs.zh: 默认编码器从零开始学习字节嵌入。 编码器是将文本转换为向量的部分。 可选的 Hugging Face 路径使用冻结的预训练编码器，其现有权重保持固定，而小型评分器进行学习。

paragraphs.en: Run these commands from the repository root. They create local synthetic data, train on it, evaluate the saved model and score one new menu.
paragraphs.zh: 请在仓库根目录下运行这些命令。 它们会创建本地合成数据、在其上训练模型、评估已保存的模型，并对一份新菜单进行评分。

sents.en: Run these commands from the repository root.
sents.zh: 请在仓库根目录下运行这些命令。

sents.en: They create local synthetic data, train on it, evaluate the saved model and score one new menu.
sents.zh: 它们会创建本地合成数据、在其上训练模型、评估已保存的模型，并对一份新菜单进行评分。

paragraphs.en: uv venv source .venv/bin/activate uv pip install -e ' .[dev] ' jevlike-data synthetic --output data/synthetic jevlike-train data/synthetic/train.jsonl \ --validation data/synthetic/validation.jsonl \ --output runs/synthetic.pt jevlike-eval runs/synthetic.pt data/synthetic/test.jsonl jevlike-predict runs/synthetic.pt \ --context " Choose the exact badge amber badger. Badge: amber badger. " \ --option " azure crane " \ --option " amber badger " \ --option " gold heron " The evaluation prints top-1 accuracy, which is the fraction of correct first choices. Top-3 accuracy is the fraction with the right answer among the three highest scores. Expected calibration error compares confidence with observed accuracy. The command also prints a shuffled-context control, which pairs each menu with the wrong context. A useful model should beat that control.
paragraphs.zh: uv venv source .venv/bin/activate uv pip install -e ' .[dev] ' jevlike-data synthetic --output data/synthetic jevlike-train data/synthetic/train.jsonl \ --validation data/synthetic/validation.jsonl \ --output runs/synthetic.pt jevlike-eval runs/synthetic.pt data/synthetic/test.jsonl jevlike-predict runs/synthetic.pt \ --context " 选择确切的徽章 amber badger。徽章：amber badger。 " \ --option " azure crane " \ --option " amber badger " \ --option " gold heron " 评估会输出 top-1 准确率，即第一次选择正确的比例。 Top-3 准确率是正确答案位于三个最高得分之中的比例。 期望校准误差将置信度与观测到的准确率进行比较。 该命令还会输出一个打乱上下文的对照组，即将每个菜单与错误的上下文配对。 一个有用的智能体模型应该优于该对照组。

paragraphs.en: The default byte encoder truncates context to 192 bytes and each option to 32 bytes. Raise --context-tokens or --option-tokens when your text needs more room. Training supports CPU, Apple MPS for a Mac GPU, and CUDA for an NVIDIA GPU through --device .
paragraphs.zh: 默认的字节编码器会将上下文截断为 192 字节，将每个选项截断为 32 字节。 当你的文本需要更多空间时，可以提高 --context-tokens 或 --option-tokens。 训练支持 CPU、用于 Mac GPU 的 Apple MPS，以及通过 --device 支持的用于 NVIDIA GPU 的 CUDA。

sents.en: The default byte encoder truncates context to 192 bytes and each option to 32 bytes.
sents.zh: 默认的字节编码器会将上下文截断为 192 字节，将每个选项截断为 32 字节。

sents.en: Raise --context-tokens or --option-tokens when your text needs more room.
sents.zh: 当你的文本需要更多空间时，可以提高 --context-tokens 或 --option-tokens。

paragraphs.en: Install the optional dependency and name any compatible encoder from Hugging Face:
paragraphs.zh: 安装可选依赖，并指定任意来自 Hugging Face 的兼容编码器名称：

paragraphs.en: uv pip install -e ' .[transformers] ' jevlike-train data/synthetic/train.jsonl \ --validation data/synthetic/validation.jsonl \ --output runs/qwen-head.pt \ --encoder hf \ --hf-model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B \ --rank 256 \ --batch-size 8 The checkpoint stores the trained scorer head and the encoder name. It does not copy the frozen encoder weights. Loading the checkpoint therefore needs access to the same Hugging Face model.
paragraphs.zh: uv pip install -e ' .[transformers] ' jevlike-train data/synthetic/train.jsonl \ --validation data/synthetic/validation.jsonl \ --output runs/qwen-head.pt \ --encoder hf \ --hf-model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B \ --rank 256 \ --batch-size 8 该检查点保存了训练好的打分头以及编码器名称。 它不会复制冻结的编码器权重。 因此，加载检查点需要访问同一个 Hugging Face 模型。

paragraphs.zh: --rank 设置小型评分器头部的宽度。 头部越宽，可训练权重越多，占用的内存也越多。

paragraphs.en: In the experiments that led to this starter, the one-pass scorer reached about 98% accuracy on synthetic menus. On target-disjoint Wikispeedia next-click data, a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B encoder plus the scorer reached 26%, against about 8% for shuffled and random-encoder controls. A small model trained from scratch on 40,000 clicks reached 29%. At eight options, one pass was about 100 times faster than a small decoder forced to write 400 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在产生这个入门方案的相关实验中，单次评分器在合成菜单上达到了约 98% 的准确率。 在目标不相交的 Wikispeedia 下一步点击数据上，冻结的 Qwen2.5-0.5B 编码器加评分器达到了 26%，而打乱对照和随机编码器对照约为 8%。 一个在 40,000 次点击上从零训练的小模型达到了 29%。 在八个选项的情况下，单次评分比一个被迫写出 400 个词元的小解码器快约 100 倍。

sents.en: In the experiments that led to this starter, the one-pass scorer reached about 98% accuracy on synthetic menus.
sents.zh: 在产生这个入门方案的相关实验中，单次评分器在合成菜单上达到了约 98% 的准确率。

sents.en: On target-disjoint Wikispeedia next-click data, a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B encoder plus the scorer reached 26%, against about 8% for shuffled and random-encoder controls.
sents.zh: 在目标不相交的 Wikispeedia 下一步点击数据上，冻结的 Qwen2.5-0.5B 编码器加评分器达到了 26%，而打乱对照和随机编码器对照约为 8%。

sents.en: A small model trained from scratch on 40,000 clicks reached 29%.
sents.zh: 一个在 40,000 次点击上从零训练的小模型达到了 29%。

sents.en: At eight options, one pass was about 100 times faster than a small decoder forced to write 400 tokens.
sents.zh: 在八个选项的情况下，单次评分比一个被迫写出 400 个词元的小解码器快约 100 倍。

paragraphs.en: These numbers describe local experiments, not this quickstart run. We did not show equal quality with Jev or reproduce TypeSafe's private training method.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数字描述的是局部实验，而非本次快速入门运行的结果。 我们并未展示与 Jev 同等的质量，也未复现 TypeSafe 的私有训练方法。
